scope: Read-only review of all 61 requirements and 88 planned cases for Simpler/Sampler/Impulse, canonical research and linked domain ownership, direct retained manual sections/text/HTML heading identity, five source pins, original schema/preset bytes, 28 payload hashes and four canonical snapshots, all 576,000 synthetic stereo frame pairs and malformed input bytes. Not a handoff release review.

findings.problem: The requirement unconditionally says Sample End terminates playback even if the volume envelope continues. The retained manual qualifies that behavior with an active-loop exception. In particular the draft itself correctly specifies a Release Loop that reaches Sample End and loops rather than terminating. The current general sentence can impose the wrong result on that documented case.

evidence.locator: Sample End list item; exception for enabled loops; Release Loop Enabled and Back-and-Forth Release Loop Enabled list items

findings.requested_change: Narrow Sample End termination to unlooped playback and preserve sustain/release-loop behavior as the controlling exception. Reconcile canonical text and requirement snapshot; add a bounded unlooped-end scenario or explicitly keep that subclause outside the finite case selection. Do not change the correctly retained loop cases or invent sample-boundary rounding.

findings.location: SIMPLER-022 and SAMPLER-025; fixtures.json setup; cases.json and the respective spec tables
findings.problem: The common fixture setup disables filter and optional modulation. SIMPLER-022 only disables LFO retrigger and changes Offset: it never enables the LFO or supplies a nonzero destination depth. SAMPLER-025 enables the filter envelope with Amount=0 but never enables the main filter. Their unchanged-audio predicates can therefore pass with the entire modulation/filter path disabled, even if Offset were wrongly applied or Amount=0 wrongly allowed modulation. The evidence supports the intended feature law, but these case preconditions do not isolate it.
evidence: fixtures.json.setup explicitly disables filter and optional modulation unless overridden.

cases.json SIMPLER-022 setup is LFO retrigger disabled; no LFO enable/wave/rate/nonzero destination is provided. Retained manual #lfo describes per-voice LFO modulation, retrigger and Offset; lack of an active routed LFO makes the negative audio observation non-discriminating.

cases.json SAMPLER-025 setup enables only the filter envelope. Retained manual #the-filter describes a filter envelope with its own F. Env switch and Amount; enabling that envelope is distinct from enabling the main filter processing path.
findings.requested_change: Explicitly override the shared neutral setup: enable the LFO, select a concrete offered rate/waveform and a nonzero audible destination for SIMPLER-022; enable and configure the main filter on spectrally suitable retained input for SAMPLER-025. Establish an active-path positive control or otherwise state a nonvacuous observable predicate before comparing retrigger-off Offset or zero envelope Amount. Keep unsupported numeric thresholds/DSP curves U. Update both case tables and cases.json, fixture setup notes if needed, then reseal; no runtime is requested.

findings.location: Cross-section evidence locators in requirements.json/cases.json and the three spec evidence links
findings.problem: All primary anchors resolve mechanically, but several selected anchors do not contain the clauses tested. A parenthetical second heading name in some requirement bodies partly signals this; the frozen case index still pins only the wrong sibling section for those behaviors. Existence of an anchor is not proof that its section supports the whole case.

findings.requested_change: Add exact secondary evidence locators where a requirement/case spans sibling sections, or split/narrow its selected clauses. Ensure case-index metadata retains the actual supporting section(s), not merely one resolving anchor. The original source captures already contain the supporting prose; preserve their bytes. Do not infer any additional signal order: the Gain paragraph only establishes separate sample Gain and final Volume after the filter, not a complete sample-Gain/filter ordering.

accepted_partial_findings.Sampler: Manual supports key/velocity/selector eligibility and selector trigger latch, layer management, current-manual Round Robin modes, per-layer/global exceptions, reverse without generated file, Link value retention, release loops, envelope controls, modulation/filter/shaper/MIDI assignments and named import routes. accepted_partial_findings.Impulse: Manual supports eight slots, C3 leftmost trigger and octave range without enumerating the six middle notes, per-sample new-note latching including automation, reciprocal 7/8 Link, named controls and distinct Gate/Trigger decay, and overall/individual output routing availability. accepted_partial_findings.fixtures: All three WAVs exactly match their declared 4-second 48 kHz stereo PCM16, identical L/R channels and 8,192-amplitude sine construction. Segmented 220/330/440/550-Hz order and distinct 660/880-Hz layers are retained input identities; they can distinguish broad region/order/source cases, not waveform equivalence or every loop marker. Empty/truncated files are deliberately malformed with no application error oracle. No external REX or official-Pack fixture is falsely claimed as supplied.
accepted_partial_findings.lifecycle_and_metrics: All 15 device lifecycle/DSP requirements and the unresolved Impulse middle-note case remain U. No numerical audio-error, timing, CPU, random, MPE/tuning or lifecycle success guarantee is invented. Proposed state/source-identity/presence predicates do not amount to executed compatibility passes, and ambiguous source identification is expressly rejected.
